title: Add public landing page for discoverability

requirements.text: Add a small, publicly accessible landing page at route "/" that introduces Foam Daddy and provides clear calls-to-action to (1) view products and (2) request a quote.

quotes: make it publicly discoverable with a small landing page

acceptanceCriteria: Visiting "/" shows a dedicated landing page (not the full product listing page).
Landing page includes prominent buttons/links to the products page and the request-quote page.
Landing page renders correctly without requiring authentication.

requirements.text: Move the current StorefrontPage (products browsing experience) off of "/" to a dedicated public route (e.g., "/products"), and update all internal navigation links so users can still easily browse products from the header/footer and from the landing page.

quotes: make it publicly discoverable with a small landing page

acceptanceCriteria: The full storefront/product browsing experience is available at the new route (e.g., "/products").
Header and footer “Products” links navigate to the new products route (not "/").
The site logo/brand link in the header navigates to the landing page at "/".
No existing non-admin routes require login; only "/admin/*" remains protected.

requirements.text: Update public-facing HTML metadata to better support discovery when the site is shared/bookmarked (title and description), keeping all user-facing text in English.

quotes: make it publicly discoverable with a small landing page

acceptanceCriteria: The document <title> and meta description in frontend/index.html reflect the new landing-page-first experience and remain accurate for the overall site.
Metadata changes do not break the SPA boot process (app still mounts and routes normally).

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn components are read-only).
Do not edit immutable hook files listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (compose them instead).
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor; do not introduce additional backend services.
Admin routes (/admin/*) must continue to require Internet Identity authentication; public routes must remain accessible without authentication.
nonGoals: No backend feature changes (products/orders/quotes data model and logic remain unchanged).
No third-party integrations for SEO/analytics or external services.
No redesign of admin workflows beyond updating navigation links as required by the new routing.
